== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Obi-Wan, Crazy Wizard (Errata)]] (<code>1261_70</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-68-Obi_Wan_Crazy_Wizard.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-obiwancrazywizard-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Obi-Wan, Crazy Wizard]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Old Ben is a Used Interrupt and may target this site even if not a Tatooine site. Dark Jedi may not 'swing' lightsabers more than once per battle here. When leaving table, place all your cards on Obi-Wan in Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number, copyright line) with this game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-68-Obi_Wan_Crazy_Wizard-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B09 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
